newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end lower after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end lower after choppy session.

text.p: Manila shares slipped at the close on Wednesday after a choppy session that focused on selected second- and third-liner issues with stories to tell, traders said.

"Everybody seems to be on a wait-and-see mode perhaps for the first quarter earnings results. The month of March is really a sluggish month," said Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities.
The main index finished 10.35 points lower at 3,270.64.
All sub-indices were down except for mining and finance. But in the broad market, gainers outnumbered decliners 73 to 55 with 73 unchanged issues.

"We are in that phase before the Holy Week break where people are pausing. We expect to see some accumulation on blue chips though as we come close to Holy Week," said Ramon Garcia, president at Diversified Securities Inc.
Traders expect the main index to trade within a 30-point range up to next week.
